decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 17th October 2007, the erection of a hip to gable roof extension with two roof windows to front of house and a new rear dormer with 3.50m projection, 2.70m high at the top not exceeding the roofline of the original house, 5.40m wide was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls inside the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the proposed extension has a volume of under 50cubic metres and the total extensions to the house will not exceed 70cubic metres.
description: Certificate of Lawful development for existing hip to gable end and rear roof extension, two x rooflights to front elevation of house and two detached outbuilding for use as store and playarea to rear garden of house
